claims: Sterling Sol Vesia was the infant daughter of Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Alex Vesia and his wife Kayla.
Sterling Sol Vesia passed away on October 26, 2025.
Alex Vesia and Kayla Vesia announced the tragedy in November 2025.
Alex Vesia and Kayla Vesia described Sterling Sol Vesia as their "little angel".
Alex Vesia honored Sterling Sol Vesia's memory with custom gear in the 2026 season.
Alex Vesia has his daughter's name "Sterling Soul" and her birthday "10-21-25" engraved on his baseball glove.
Kayla Vesia called their return to Dodger Stadium in March 2026 "bittersweet".
The Dodgers organization offered support to the Vesia family.
Fans offered support to the Vesia family.
Alex Vesia and Kayla Vesia received support from the baseball community following their announcement
